segments.text: A surgeon has the best medical books, latest instruments and a very fast calculator.
He can answer the question of diagnosis.
But if he doesn't remember the old history of the patient,
can't plan the operation steps,
can't check his results,
and can't learn anything from the real patient's reaction,
then will he be a complete doctor?
Maybe not.
He has powerful tools,
but for a complete intelligent system,
he will need memory, planning, checking and feedback from the real world.
A similar question is coming up about AI today.
Transformer models have shown great progress in language, images, code and reasoning.
Models have learned patterns from many examples,
they can answer questions,
they can make summaries,
they can write codes,
they can give descriptions of pictures.
Bigger models and more training have made these abilities better.
But the central question is not whether the transformer is powerful or not.
The transformer is really powerful.
The real question is,
can a transformer be a complete AGI architecture?
Or a wider system for AGI,
in which there is memory, planning, world model, tools,
continual learning and verification with the transformer?
To understand the transformer,
a reader's example is
when a person reads a sentence,
he doesn't see every word as a separate island,
he makes connections between the words.
If the sentence is,
when did Sara keep the table, because it was clean,
then a person thinks that it can be a table.
If the sentence is,
when did Sara keep the table, because it broke,
then when can it be?
A reader focuses more on relevant parts of the sentence.
In the transformer, this focus is called attention.
Attention means to give some of the parts of the input
more importance than other parts.
The model sees which words can be related to which words.
Then it predicts the next words,
the answer or the output with the help of these relations.
This process is not simple,
but the basic idea is the same.
System gives a weed to relevant connections.
When it comes to training,
the transformer sees a lot of data.
Books, websites, conversations,
code, images and other examples.
Every example helps the model to realize
what pattern can come in which situation.
Internal numbers keep adjusting.
Gradually, grammar, style, facts,
and some reasoning patterns are filled.
That is why in larger models,
it often sees more useful abilities.
But training and daily learning are not the same.
The basic parameters of the model in training
are an update during a special process.
After the training is over,
the model usually works with its existing knowledge.
In conversation, it can answer your first question
and answer the second question.
It can be called context.
But context does not mean that the core memory
of the model has permanently changed.
An employee is told in a meeting that
Project Blue's report has to be sent to Friday.
The employee uses this during the meeting.
But if this is not saved in its permanent records,
then after a few weeks,
it will not remember the name of the project.
AI context is also sometimes
like a temporary working memory.
It can use the information in front of it,
but the question of long-term memory is different.
Long-term memory does not mean
to keep everything in a very long list.
The system will have to decide
what to save, which detail to ignore,
which old memory to update,
which memory to retrieve again,
and if there is conflict in two memories,
then what to trust.
Consider the example of a student.
A student has a working memory.
He keeps the steps of a math problem in mind.
He has past experience.
He remembers what kind of questions
the teacher had asked in the last test.
He also has a skill memory.
He knows how to solve fractions.
The AGI system may also need
different kinds of memory.
Working memory can handle current tasks.
Long-term memory can keep old events,
facts and preferences.
Skill memory tells how to do something.
But memory does not create intelligence alone.
If the employee has thousands of files,
but he could not find the right files at the right time,
then the files will not make him smart.
Memory has to be retrieved, organized,
updated and verified.
Here the challenge of planning comes forward.
Planning does not just write a list.
Planning means breaking the goal in small steps,
checking the resources, taking action,
looking at the results and planning on the needs.
For example, a research assistant
should be told to prepare a report.
He will first understand the questions,
then find relevant sources,
then check the reliability of the sources,
then make notes, then prepare an outline,
then write a draft.
After that, he will verify the facts.
If any source is missing,
he will search again.
This is a loop from the goal to the result.
A simple chatbot may write the steps of the plan,
but writing the plan
and following the plan consistently
for hours or days is different.
In real planning, the deadline,
missing information, changing conditions
and the failure are to be handled.
AGI may need a planner
who can change the response of the transformer
into the sequence of actions.
Planning will only be useful
when the system can understand the results of the world.
Here comes the idea of the world model.
The world model is an internal working model
of objects, rules and cause and effect.
The person who crosses the road
first sees the cars.
He realizes how far the car is
and how fast it is coming.
Then he chooses a safe moment.
If the robot raises the cup,
then he needs the position, weight, grip
and the edge of the table.
The robot predicts
in its internal model
which direction to move the hand.
If the grip is weak, then the cup can fall.
After action, the robot checks the reality.
Whether the cup was raised or not,
whether it was on the table or down.
This is the connection between prediction and feedback.
The world model does not mean consciousness.
It means there is no human-like experience.
It can be just a working prediction system.
It can give the system the idea
that if I do this action,
then what is possible?
The world model can be wrong too.
That is why real world checking is necessary.
Tools can increase the reach of the AI system.
Browser can search for the latest information.
Calculator can check the numbers.
Code execution tool can run the program.
It can give records of the database company.
It can show the scene of the camera room.
It can tell the robot's sensors,
temperature, distance and movement.
This whole process can be seen
as a loop.
Think, Act, Observe, Update.
The system first thinks,
then takes action in the tool or environment,
then observes the results,
then updates for the next decision.
If the result of the calculator is not matched
with the expected answer,
the system can check its answer again.
But the tool use is not an automatic solution.
The AI can choose the wrong website,
can read the wrong database field,
can give the code the wrong input.
The result of the tool is correct,
but the system can misunderstand it.
Therefore, verification and permissions
can also be important.
The issue of hallucination becomes important
in this place.
Sometimes, AI makes such an answer with a lot of confidence
that it seems right to listen,
but it is actually wrong.
It can give fake citations,
can tell the wrong date,
can make the name of such a person
that does not exist.
AI is not deliberately lying.
It is likely generating words.
Fluent answer is not a guaranteed answer.
Self-monitoring means noticing
your uncertainty.
The system should be said
that I do not have enough evidence
or that this result needs to be verified
from an external source.
Or that I need human help.
This is not a weakness.
It can be a safe behaviour.
A doctor does not give a final answer in every case.
He asks for a test,
takes a second opinion,
or sends the patient to a specialist.
The question of continual learning is also very important.
Continual learning means
that the system keeps improving with time
with new information
and new experiences.
Students learn new subjects every month,
but they do not forget the previous subjects.
The ideal system should also add new knowledge
and preserve useful old knowledge.
Here, there is a problem of catastrophic forgetting.
Students learn physics,
but after physics, they forget
the rules of basic mathematics.
The new subject improved,
but the old skill got damaged.
In AI, new training can weaken the old ability.
Researchers are exploring replay,
separate modules, memory protection
and other methods.
But there is no final guarantee
that every system can learn safely and permanently.
Spars, neural networks
and mixture of experts
are another idea of this architecture.
In hospitals, there are heart doctors,
eye doctors and bone doctors.
For every patient, the whole hospital is not active.
Relevant specialist is called.
In AI, router can select
relevant experts by looking at input.
Maths question can go to a math expert.
Coding request to a coding expert.
Translation to a language expert.
With this approach,
it is not necessary to activate all the model parts on every input.
Resources can be saved.
A large system can be made efficient.
But the router can select wrong experts.
The workload of experts can be unequal.
And by adding specialist modules,
human intelligence cannot be automatically created.
Now, understand abstraction and
transfer learning.
Students learn to ride a cycle.
After that, they do not look at the motorcycle at all.
Balance, road and steering
have some idea of earlier.
They transfer their old skills
in a new situation.
In school, a student learning maths
can easily understand some formulas of physics.
For AI, transfer learning
means to use a task
that is learned from a task in a different task.
But transfer is not always successful.
The strategy used in the game
can fail in real business.
The data of the laboratory cannot
represent traffic.
That is why grounding can be necessary
The system will have to check its assumptions
with real examples and real feedback.
Now, imagine an AGI architecture.
First, it can be a perception layer.
Take this camera, text, sound
or sensor for information.
Then it can be a transformer reasoning core.
Connect this language and patterns.
Hold the working memory current task.
Store the long term memory in old events or facts.
Divide the planner goal into steps.
Predict world model possible outcomes.
Access to tools, browser, calculator,
code and database.
Tell the result of environment feedback action.
Update the continual learning system with time.
Check the verification layer,
answer and action.
Information will move between these modules.
Perception can send the input to the transformer.
The transformer can explain the planner's goals.
The planner can give action to the tool.
The tool can get the result back to the system.
The world model result can be compared.
The memory can be measured
and very important experience can be saved.
The verification layer can say
whether the answer matches the evidence or not.
Then the system can choose the next step.
This diagram can look complete.
But it is not a guarantee to list the modules
to be AGI.
Coordination can be difficult.
Memory can store wrong details.
The planner can follow the wrong goal.
The world model can give inaccurate prediction.
The tool can be misused.
Continual learning can be unsafe.
The system can be matched
and work well.
But it can look weak in the unfamiliar real world.
It can look weak in the unfamiliar real world.
It is different to have departments
and coordination of departments.
If the sales team and engineering team
do not understand each other's information,
then the company may fail
despite having talented people.
In AGI architecture,
clear communication between modules
can be required for priorities, permissions
and feedback.
Therefore, the bigger transformer
cannot be ignored.
In the bigger model, more patterns,
more representations and more flexible reasoning
can come.
With larger training, capabilities can be improved.
But the other systems of the vehicle
cannot be automatically built with the bigger engine.
Memory management, long term planning,
real world grounding, verification
and safe learning can be different engineering problems.
No one has the final answer yet.
Researchers are exploring
whether a giant model will be enough for AGI
or whether the group and external modules
will be needed.
It is possible that the central brain transformer
of the future system is there.
It is possible that specialized experts,
memory stores, planners, world models
or tools are connected to it.
It is possible that architecture is different from all of them.
The most important thing is
not to make speculation a proof.
There is no guarantee of consciousness,
there is no guarantee of understanding,
there is no guarantee of reliable action,
there is no guarantee of safe general intelligence,
there is no guarantee of safe general intelligence,
there is no guarantee of relevant memory retrieving,
planning the goal, actionally,
observing the results, understanding the uncertainty
and correcting mistakes and improving
the new experience.
These old useful skills were denied.
The return of the example of a surgeon
can be powerful with books and instruments.
But the history of the patient,
the plan of the operation, the life feedback,
safety checks and the team coordination
is not possible without the complete care.
Even for AGI, the transformer can be a powerful
and intellectual engine.
But the engine and complete cognitive system is not the same.
So the better question is not whether the Transformers will end.
The better question is what architecture to keep the Transformers inside.
It may be working memory, long term memory, planning,
world models, tools, continual learning, verification
and real world feedback.
It may be the final design that is hidden from us.
The final architecture has not yet been proved
but the direction is clear.
For AGI, only more text, more parameters
or more fluent answers may not be enough.
Seeing a complete system, remembering, planning,
acting, checking results and safely updating your learning
can also be done.
If AGI develops in the future,
then it may not be a single model
but a connected cognitive system.
The Transformer can be the important reasoning core of that system
but with that memory, planning, world models, tools,
continual learning and verification layers can also be needed.
And until these modules work in a reliable way,
we may have powerful AI but the AGI will be completed soon.
